title: Settings
programsHint: Games launchers installed in this prefix. Click to open them directly, without going through the launcher screen.
programsEmpty: No launcher-installed games in this prefix. Install them through the launcher (EA app, Battle.net, Ubisoft Connect…) and they show up here.
profileOverlayHint: Overlay: the launcher's prefix stays as the base; each profile keeps only what changes. Works on any disk.
profileReflinkHint: Reflink: an instant copy of the prefix sharing its data with the original; only changes take space.
profileReflinkUnavailable: Reflink needs the prefix on a Btrfs, XFS or bcachefs disk.
profileRemoveWarning: This game's profile will be deleted: its mods, saves and settings. The game stays installed in the launcher.
